other_conditions: Beneficiary must be a Farmer Producer Company (FPC), Farmer Interest Group (FIG) or Farmer Producer Organization (FPO) registered under MOVCDNER
Must have a minimum contiguous area of organic cultivation or conversion of at least 400 hectares
Marketing infrastructure must be located within 25 km radius of the registered clusters
For processing unit assistance, the entity must have between 250 and 500 members
Applicants must not have previously received subsidy from any other State or Central Government department/agency
Projects must route all transactions through banks and the beneficiary must meet its share of the project cost
Assistance may be provided without credit link only if the beneficiary can meet its share of costs
The facility (processing unit, pack house, cold chain) must meet technical and commodity‑specific standards and be able to operate at least 8‑10 months a year
Implementation is limited to the eight North Eastern states listed
benefits_summary: Provides subsidised financial assistance for setting up organic value‑chain infrastructure—including collection, processing, pack houses and cold‑chain facilities—for farmer groups and entrepreneurs in the North‑Eastern region.
